summary: Accumulates a steering input step into two float state fields on a float-array object. Chooses a multiplier of 2.0 when argument a3 equals 1, else 0.5, and negates it when the low byte of the float input a2 is zero. The signed product of the multiplier and input delta a4 is added to field this[40] (this+0xA0) and then to field this[47] (this+0xBC); after each update the value is passed to InterruptDispatch (0058957A) and written back to the same field. No early-return guards.

local_names.a2: float steering input whose low byte selects direction (negation)
local_names.a3: integer mode selecting the 2.0 vs 0.5 multiplier
local_names.a4: input delta scaled by the multiplier before accumulation
local_names.v7: sign-scaled delta reused for both accumulators

operations.description: Multiplier selection: base 0.5, raised to 2.0 when a3 == 1, and negated when the low byte of a2 is zero
Scaled input delta computed as multiplier * a4
Primary accumulator: adds the scaled delta to the float at this+0xA0 (element [40]), passes the sum to InterruptDispatch (0058957A), then writes the (possibly clamped) result back to this+0xA0
Secondary accumulator: adds the same scaled delta to the float at this+0xBC (element [47]), passes the sum to InterruptDispatch (0058957A), then writes the (possibly clamped) result back to this+0xBC
